quote.text: Health is not everything. But without health, everything is nothing.

pillars.heading: Four Pillars
pillars.subheading: A beautiful life is built on four foundations. Each one is essential. Together, they are unbeatable.

items.title: Movement
items.desc: The body is made to move. We will find an exercise you love — not one that punishes you.

items.title: Nutrition
items.desc: Food is pleasure, not penance. Mediterranean nutrition philosophy for everyday life.

items.title: Community
items.desc: Surround yourself with people who inspire you. Together we go further and stay the course longer.

items.title: Mindset
items.desc: Change begins in the mind. We will teach you to think like someone who truly takes care of themselves.

about.heading: Alessandro
about.body1: I grew up by the sea — in an environment where movement, food, and friends were a natural part of the day. Not a duty, but a joy. That philosophy came with me.
about.body2: In over ten years of working with clients, I have learned one thing: lasting change does not come from relentless drilling. It comes from genuine interest in oneself — from understanding your body, your rhythm, and your values.
about.body3: La Bella Vita is not a programme. It is a way of life. And I am here to help you find yours.

transformations.heading: Transformation Stories
transformations.subheading: No before-and-after shots. Just real stories from real people who chose a different life.

items.name: Martina, 34
items.story: After my second child I felt lost in my own body. Alessandro helped me find myself again — not just physically, but above all mentally. In eight months I lost 14 kg, but more importantly, I now look forward to moving every morning.

items.name: Tomáš, 41
items.story: I work in a corporate office, sitting eight hours a day. My spine was sending signals that this could not go on. With Alessandro we built a plan around my packed schedule. Today I have the strength I had at twenty-five.

items.name: Katarína, 28
items.story: I was never a 'sporty person'. La Bella Vita showed me that movement does not have to be aggressive or stressful. Now we run together by the sea twice a week and I look forward to it all day.

cta1.sentence: Maybe today is the day you begin.

howIWork.heading: How I Work
howIWork.subheading: No generic plans. Only your plan — from the first meeting to your first milestone.

steps.title: First Meeting
steps.desc: A free one-hour consultation — we get to know each other, discuss your goals, and I find out what you truly need.

steps.title: Body Analysis
steps.desc: A Visbody scan reveals exact body composition, muscle imbalances, and metabolic values — data, not guesswork.

steps.title: Your Plan
steps.desc: Based on the analysis I build a training and nutrition plan made specifically for you. No templates from the internet.

steps.title: The Journey Together
steps.desc: We train together, regularly review progress, and fine-tune the plan along the way. I am available to you every day.

food.heading:
Food as pleasure,
not punishment.
food.body1: I collaborate with certified nutritionist Zuzana Nováková, who shares my Mediterranean nutrition philosophy. Together we create nutritional plans that are delicious, sustainable, and adapted to your lifestyle.
food.body2: No forbidden foods. No counting calories down to the last gram. Instead, we teach you to eat intelligently — with your head and with pleasure.

financing.heading: La Bella Vita Financing Programme
financing.body: We believe health care should never be a question of finances. That is why we offer a flexible, zero-interest instalment plan — spread your investment in your own health into comfortable monthly payments and start without stress.

events.heading: La Bella Vita Events
events.subheading: Something happens every week. Join in — movement is more beautiful when you share it.

cta2.sentence: Your best year starts with one step.

corporate.heading: Corporate Wellbeing
corporate.subheading: Healthy employees are more productive, happier, and more loyal. Investing in wellbeing is investing in your business.
offerings: Group training sessions at your office or in nature
Wellness workshops and talks on healthy living
Visbody body-composition analysis for the whole team

Team-building activities in motion — running, volleyball, swimming
Long-term wellness programmes tailored to your company culture

instagram.heading: Follow Us
instagram.subheading: Daily inspiration, movement, and beautiful life — straight to your feed.
